# ElectricalLicenseRenewal.com

> > Continuing education and exam preparation platform for electrical license renewal across Washington, Oregon, Texas, and Utah.

ElectricalLicenseRenewal.com provides state-specific continuing education courses, exam preparation resources, and license renewal services for electricians. The platform covers Washington electrical code (RCW 19.28), regulatory compliance, and certification requirements administered by state departments of labor and electrical boards.

## Key Topics

- Continuing Education (CE) Courses
- Electrical License Renewal
- RCW 19.28 (Washington Electrical Code)
- Electrician Certification
- Electrical Exam Preparation
- Washington Department of Labor and Industries
- State Electrical Boards
- Oregon Electrical Licensing
- Texas Electrical Licensing
- Utah Electrical Licensing
- RCW 19.28.006 (Definitions)
- RCW 19.28.311 (Requirements)
- Electrician Licensing Requirements
- Revised Code of Washington
- Professional Development

## Registration & Getting Started

- [Electrical License Renewal Register For CE Courses](https://www.electricallicenserenewal.com/Electrical-Continuing-Education-Courses-Register.php): Registration page for electrical continuing education courses

## Exam Preparation

- [Electrical Exam Prep](https://www.electricallicenserenewal.com/Electrical-Exam-Prep.php): Electrical exam preparation courses for license renewal & certification

## Washington Electrical Code & Regulations

- [RCW 19.28.006 Definitions](https://www.electricallicenserenewal.com/Electrical-Continuing-Education-Courses/NEC-Content.php?sectionID=3190.0): WA electrical code definitions course covering RCW 19.28.006 standards
